name: remote-turns-expire-per-session
description: Session alpha starts a turn at minute 0 and session beta at minute 10, and neither is heard from again. At minute 15 alpha expires but beta is still within its fifteen minutes, so the status stays thinking; at minute 25 beta expires too and the status goes idle.
reason: Each session's turn has its own expiry clock. Expiring one session's silent turn must not end another session's live one.
source: DESIGN.md v1.10 'remoteActiveTurns maps session id → last sign of life' and 'Expiry'; AppState.refreshRemoteTurnActive

script.reason: Focus alpha, so the status shows alpha's turn alone.
Just past minute 15: alpha has been silent for fifteen minutes.
Focus beta: its turn (started at minute 10) is still alive.
Just past minute 25: beta has been silent for fifteen minutes too.

transcript.text: Focus → alpha — only this session is spoken now.
Focus → beta — only this session is spoken now.
